source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Convert status from q430 ("in what religion were you raised"): "Lifelong" is raised Mormon, "Convert" is raised anything else (don't know/refused on q430 excluded from both groups). Each item's own don't know/refused excluded from its own denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
